MAIN.RawInputMouse.description: Uses relative raw mouse movement during gameplay. Menus keep the game's cursor and controls.
plugin.name: Tony Hawk's Underground 2 Fusion Fix
FPSLimit.description: Limits the frame rate. Higher rates may affect gameplay. 0 is unlimited; -1 uses the monitor refresh rate.
ResX.description: 0 uses the desktop resolution. Set both width and height to use another one. Takes effect when the game starts.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the Intel, Dolby, Activision, Neversoft and Beenox logos and the intro movie when the game starts. Options > Movies still plays them. Takes effect at the next start.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Widens or narrows the skating camera. 1.0 is the game's own framing. Cutscenes, fixed and zoomed views keep theirs.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original aspect shows the movies as the game does, whole inside its centred 4:3 frame with black bars around them. Fill fits the whole movie to the screen, without cutting anything off or stretching it.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Where the HUD sits on wide screens. Automatic puts the score, special meter, goal points and phone at the left edge and the current goal at the right edge. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps them in a centred box of that shape. Elements in the middle of the screen stay centred.
MAIN_ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while it is active. Released while unfocused, dragging or using system menus, and at once when turned off.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu (this fix and other plugins). Automatic follows the game.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Enhanced: everything turned up
CutsceneBorders.description: Story cutscenes and goal scenes show a wide picture between black bars. Both keeps that picture as it was. Top/bottom spans the screen width between the bars, Sides fills the screen height up to the picture's shape, None fills the whole screen. Applies immediately.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game stops while another window is active, as it always did. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
checkupdates.description: Checks once for a new fix version when turned on. A notice appears in the Plugins menu; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if it is installed. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: An update for Tony Hawk's Underground 2 Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Tony Hawk's Underground 2 Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
